title: Moonkin
wikitext:
[[image:Moonkins.png|thumb|A Tauren druid as a Moonkin next to a wild Moonkin]]
A beastly humanoid native to [[Darkshore]].  Sometimes called an "owlbear", these large bipedal creatures have the size of an upright walking bear, but with bird-like features such as a beak, feathers, and flightless wings. They also drop [[egg]]s of various sorts.  Related to the [[Wildkin]].
[[Night elf]] [[Druid]]s must fight a moonkin named [[Lunaclaw]] to earn their [[Bear Form]], and if they choose the highest tier talent in the [[Druid Talents#Balance|Balance]] tree, druids can assume [[Moonkin Form]] themselves.
